name: Buyer Protection Selection Criteria 1
definition: Selection criteria for buyer protection query.

FinancialInstitutionIdentification.name: Financial Institution Identification
FinancialInstitutionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Selected safekeeping accounts list to which the corporate action event applies.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN). A numbering system designed by the United Nation's International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO). The ISIN is composed of a 2-character prefix representing the country of issue, followed by the national security number (if one exists), and a check digit. Each country has a national numbering agency that assigns ISIN numbers for securities in that country.

CorporateActionEventIdentification.name: Corporate Action Event Identification
CorporateActionEventIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

UniqueTransactionIdentifier.name: Unique Transaction Identifier
UniqueTransactionIdentifier.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.
